name: What is the difference between a full bathroom remodel and a bathroom refresh?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a full bathroom remodel and a bathroom refresh?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full bathroom remodel typically involves gutting the space to update layout, plumbing, electrical, tile, vanity, and fixtures, whereas a cosmetic refresh only updates surface features like paint or hardware. In a full remodel, you gain the ability to fix hidden water damage, relocate supply and drain lines, and rebuild shower pans with modern waterproofing. The tradeoff is a higher budget and longer downtime. If your drywall is deteriorating, your subfloor shows signs of rot, or you want to convert a tub to a walk-in shower, a complete renovation is usually the safer, longer-lasting decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full remodel replaces infrastructure, plumbing, tile, and layout down to the studs, while a refresh only swaps surface cosmetics like paint, light fixtures, or vanity hardware.
